scope: CPU control-inwait ordering only. No GPU completion, numerical, memory or speed claim.

leaves.name: control-inwait-pause-and-cold-start
leaves.replaces: Initial EngineCore startup, PauseState and request/model objects from test_append_yield.Rig
leaves.equivalence: Uses the real disarm and all-rank FULL transition before installing a fresh real AutoArmPolicy. Pause includes UNPAUSED, PAUSED_NEW and PAUSED_ALL; set_pause_state preserves both the scheduler state and Core's is_scheduler_paused semantics. MIN_NATIVE_ROWS=1 scales the existing real chunk planner to the rig's 12-token prompt. KV, graph dispatch and CUDA/PP leaves are inherited. All eight A/Y1/Y2 combinations exercise a real bulk (7 rows left > max_new=6), yield, append, FULL handback and re-entry. Cohort, Request identity, plan, phase, generation and typed route-fence decisions are production code.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real scheduler throughput, CUDA graph support/counts, numerical identity or physical stream completion.

leaves.name: control-inwait-four-worker-ordered-mq
leaves.replaces: MultiprocWorker process loop, shared-memory broadcast ring and model execute/sample kernels
leaves.equivalence: Four actual CPU threads consume one FIFO each. Native commands call the existing four real NativeWorkerBridge/native_overlap_worker handlers. execute_model sets the runner's outstanding execute state and refreshes CPU prefill counts as pinned update_requests does; sample_tokens clears it and returns a CPU payload. A test gate holds sample_tokens, with identity submitted behind it before output application. Uses real BoundedSender, ReplyTransport and StockLocalFuture plus pinned generated MultiprocExecutor execute/sample/collective_rpc bodies. Native replies cannot steal ordinary replies; every worker order and remaining credits are asserted. Queues represent immediate readable ring credits and do not simulate PP/NCCL or backpressure.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real multiprocess MQ timing, device execution/fences, inter-GPU sends, ring exhaustion or fatal pipe delivery; existing transport/fatal suites cover their CPU paths separately.

leaves.name: control-inwait-core-output-application
leaves.replaces: Scheduler token selection, GPU ModelRunnerOutput and its contents; logging/iteration metadata
leaves.equivalence: Executes the SHA-pinned generated EngineCore.step_with_batch_queue unchanged, including enqueue, pop-before-result, abort processing, scheduler.update_from_output and deferred grammar sample. schedule/has_requests produce decode-only CPU work under PAUSED_NEW and none under PAUSED_ALL. update_from_output records real application and may remove a finished decoder; it never edits a control reply or invents completion. Future readiness, queue membership and applied output are distinct. check_for_draft_tokens=False matches the no-MTP launch; capture_iteration_details/log_error_detail are null contexts. The final bank cut is authorized only on the next outer Core tick; no policy tick is injected in Future.result.
leaves.cannot_prove: Full stock scheduler/KV allocation, real output content, client token gaps or device idle time.

leaves.name: control-inwait-proof-mutations
leaves.replaces: Fault injection and frozen-parent module loading
leaves.equivalence: Request replacement, cohort finish, route generation change, worker prefill/count refusal, deadline, yield revocation and a zero drained-stream count are injected individually. Six source mutants must fail connected assertions: no overlap, no output cut, stale request, stale generation, omitted identity proof, omitted device-fence proof. git show reads frozen 46d28946 into a distinct module for default-off command/pause/status equality; no branch, source or reference is changed.
leaves.cannot_prove: Frequency of real races or transition savings; default-off proof compares semantic receipts, excluding nondeterministic clock values.
